notes: Frozen v1.0, 2026-10-02 ~23:55 ET, written before any backtest; see docs/research/literature.md sections A-D. Sign +1 = the feature rises under deception/stress and so raises the tell score. Weight rule, applied mechanically: (1) |g| from a meta-analysis that used the same operationalization as our feature (software word counts: Hauch et al. 2015); else (2) construct-level |d| from DePaulo et al. 2003, averaged with Sporer & Schwandt 2006/2007 where both exist; else (3) 0.15 for signs that are significant only in the in-domain CEO study (Larcker & Zakolyukina 2012), which has no d. The 0.15 default sits above the DePaulo median |d| of 0.10 because L&Z is the only evidence from executives; the consequence is that L&Z-only text cues outweigh lab-measured text cues, which we accept and disclose. Inclusion rule: the cue's CI excludes zero in at least one meta-analysis for the construct, or its sign is significant in L&Z. Modality weights are equal (face = voice = text = incongruence = 1.0), so each is 25% when all are present; Bond & DePaulo 2006 (human judges: audio 63% vs video 52%) concerns human accuracy, not machine-measured cue validity, so it is not treated as strong evidence for unequal weights. fc_gesture_energy sits in the face block because assemble.py names it fc_; it requires fc_hands_visible >= 0.5. Incongruence as implemented in src/pokerface/signal.py is max(z(txt_lm_net_tone),0) * max(m_face,0): upbeat words while the face shows tension (Koo, Teoh, Yoo & Zhao 2026 modal incongruence; DePaulo 2003 genuine smiles d=-0.70, k=2, when faking positive affect). txt_lm_net_tone is used rather than txt_extreme_positive so that the incongruence term does not double count a text-block feature. Excluded for reasons other than folklore: fc_duchenne_frac (k=2, conditional on feigned positive affect; it motivates the incongruence term instead), fc_brow_down (DePaulo cue 056 d=+0.04, n.s.), txt_first_singular (DePaulo self-references d=-0.03 n.s.; Hauch cue 21 g=-0.06 n.s., wrong direction), txt_hedge/txt_hedge_word/txt_lm_uncertainty/txt_lm_weak_modal (Hauch cue 12: liars use FEWER tentative words, g=+0.13 [0.06, 0.20], while DePaulo rated uncertainty is +0.30 and finance links LM uncertainty to risk, so the sign conflicts), txt_certainty (Hauch cue 14 g=-0.06 n.s.), txt_lm_positive (L&Z non-extreme positive is not separable from extreme positive with our lists; Hauch cue 19.1 g=-0.07 n.s.), txt_lm_negative/txt_extreme_negative (DePaulo negative statements +0.21 conflicts with L&Z CEO signs), txt_type_token_ratio (Hauch cue 03 g=+0.14 is significant, but our TTR is computed on up to the first 1000 tokens and is length-confounded; a moving-average TTR would be needed), txt_denial (our own list, no published d), voc_loudness (DePaulo cue 032 d=-0.05 n.s.). The excluded folk cues are kept as columns and combined into a pre-registered FOLK placebo (equal-weight mean of their z-scores, sign +1) that is predicted to have no return predictability.
